|lore=Corellian bounty hunter. Assassin trained by the Empire. Has reflex-enhancing cyber-implants. Gravely injured during a swoop race in the crystal swamp of Agrilat. Blames Han Solo.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys free aboard Punishing One, and while piloting it, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Cancels Han's game text at same site. Immune to creature attacks and Fallen Portal.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Dengar (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): first release sheet “Virtual Set #5” (Players Committee, 30 May 2003; tournament legal 6 June 2003), page 3, slip 34 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf PDF on theforce.net] linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20030603182926/http://swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm PC news post of 30 May 2003] (Internet Archive capture of the PDF, 1 August 2003; PDF dated 30–31 May 2003): “P 2. Deploys free aboard Punishing One, and while piloting it, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Cancels Han's game text at same site. Immune to creature attacks and Fallen Portal.” Stats line: “POWER 2 ABILITY 2”. Deploy 3, forfeit 6. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “5•34” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The revised sheet of 11 June 2003 (PDF dated 11 June 2003; the copy the Players Committee still hosts at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf res.starwarsccg.org]) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS5-34-Dengar-original-slip-2003-06-11.png]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114014729/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections381-batch2-primary-sources.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Dengar (V) (Virtual Set 5) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 34), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys free aboard ''Punishing One'', and while piloting it, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. At same site, Han’s game text is canceled. May not be attacked. Immune to Fallen Portal.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
